description: A parameter that requires power-off was input.
possible_causes: A parameter requiring power-off was changed.
corrective_action: Turn CNC power OFF and ON after the required parameter change, following the maintenance manual.

description: Parameter-write-enable is active.
possible_causes: PWE (parameter write enable) is set ON.
corrective_action: After completing the intended parameter change, set parameter write enable back to OFF and reset as specified by the manual.

description: The servo ready signal VRDY of a servo amplifier is OFF although the position-control ready signal PRDY is ON.
possible_causes: Servo amplifier not ready; another servo alarm may be the preceding cause; power magnetic circuit around amplifier; servo amplifier or CNC axis-control hardware fault.
corrective_action: If another servo alarm is present, troubleshoot the first alarm first. Check the power magnetic circuit around the amplifier and the applicable servo amplifier/CNC axis-control hardware.
source_document: B-64305EN/03 Appendix A; maintenance section on SV0401

description: The combination of the axis-control card and servo software is incorrect.
possible_causes: Incorrect axis-control card; incorrect servo software installed in flash memory.
corrective_action: Verify the installed axis-control card and the servo software installed in flash memory against the machine configuration.

description: The servo velocity-control ready signal VRDY is ON although position-control ready PRDY is OFF.
possible_causes: Servo ready-state mismatch between position and velocity control.
corrective_action: Check the servo-control state and follow the FANUC servo troubleshooting procedure for the machine configuration.

description: An abnormal load was detected on the servo motor; the manual notes Cs-axis or spindle-positioning cases for T-series configurations.
possible_causes: Abnormal servo-motor load.
corrective_action: Investigate the mechanical load and servo system using FANUC servo diagnostics. The alarm can be cancelled by RESET according to the alarm list.

description: Position deviation during stopping exceeded the value set in parameter No. 1829.
possible_causes: Stopping position deviation exceeded parameter 1829.
corrective_action: Check the position deviation and servo tuning/mechanical condition according to the FANUC maintenance procedure; verify parameter No. 1829.

description: Position deviation during travel exceeded the value set in parameter No. 1828.
possible_causes: Moving position deviation exceeded parameter 1828.
corrective_action: Check the servo system, mechanical load and parameter No. 1828 according to FANUC maintenance procedure.

description: The counter for the amount of positional deviation overflowed.
possible_causes: Positional-deviation counter overflow.
corrective_action: Use FANUC servo diagnostics and maintenance procedures to identify the condition that caused the deviation counter to overflow.

description: A velocity exceeding the travel-velocity limit was commanded.
possible_causes: Commanded velocity exceeded the travel velocity limit.
corrective_action: Check the commanded motion and the applicable axis/velocity parameters and correct the program or configuration as required.

description: An illegal digital-servo parameter was detected.
possible_causes: Possible causes include an out-of-range motor model setting at parameter 2020, incorrect motor-rotation direction setting at parameter 2022, or other illegal digital-servo parameter settings.
corrective_action: Identify the cause using the FANUC diagnostic information referenced by the alarm list and correct the applicable servo parameters.

description: The servo motor overheat condition is detected.
possible_causes: Servo motor temperature/overheat condition.
corrective_action: Inspect the servo motor, cooling condition and associated thermal/servo circuitry using the applicable FANUC maintenance procedure.

description: The converter is overloaded.
possible_causes: Converter overload.
corrective_action: Inspect the converter/power system using FANUC maintenance diagnostics and the applicable drive procedure.

description: The converter control-voltage condition is too low.
possible_causes: Converter control-voltage low condition.
corrective_action: Check the converter/power-supply system and associated wiring according to the FANUC maintenance procedure.

description: The converter DC-link voltage is too low.
possible_causes: Converter DC-link low-voltage condition.
corrective_action: Check incoming power, converter and DC-link circuitry according to FANUC maintenance procedure.

description: The inverter control-voltage condition is too low.
possible_causes: Inverter control-voltage low condition.
corrective_action: Check inverter power/control circuitry using FANUC maintenance diagnostics.

description: The inverter DC-link voltage is too low.
possible_causes: Inverter DC-link low-voltage condition.
corrective_action: Check the inverter, DC-link circuit and incoming power according to FANUC maintenance procedure.

description: A soft-thermal/overload condition is detected in the servo system.
possible_causes: Servo overload/thermal accumulation.
corrective_action: Check servo load, acceleration/deceleration, mechanical resistance and cooling according to FANUC servo troubleshooting.

description: The positive-side stored-stroke check 1 was exceeded.
possible_causes: Commanded or actual axis position exceeded the positive stored-stroke-check-1 limit.
corrective_action: Move the axis back within the permitted travel using the machine's approved recovery procedure; check stored-stroke parameters and machine configuration before resuming.

description: The negative-side stored-stroke check 1 was exceeded.
possible_causes: Commanded or actual axis position exceeded the negative stored-stroke-check-1 limit.
corrective_action: Move the axis back within the permitted travel using the machine's approved recovery procedure; check stored-stroke parameters and machine configuration before resuming.

description: The positive-side stored-stroke check 2 was exceeded; the manual also describes a positive-direction entry into an inhibited area for applicable chuck/tailstock barrier configurations.
possible_causes: Positive stored-stroke-check-2 violation or applicable barrier violation.
corrective_action: Use the machine's approved recovery procedure to return inside the permitted area and verify stored-stroke/barrier settings.

description: The negative-side stored-stroke check 2 was exceeded; the manual also describes a negative-direction entry into an inhibited area for applicable chuck/tailstock barrier configurations.
possible_causes: Negative stored-stroke-check-2 violation or applicable barrier violation.
corrective_action: Use the machine's approved recovery procedure to return inside the permitted area and verify stored-stroke/barrier settings.

description: The positive-side stored-stroke check 3 was exceeded.
possible_causes: Positive stored-stroke-check-3 violation.
corrective_action: Use the machine's approved recovery procedure and verify the relevant stored-stroke settings.

description: The negative-side stored-stroke check 3 was exceeded.
possible_causes: Negative stored-stroke-check-3 violation.
corrective_action: Use the machine's approved recovery procedure and verify the relevant stored-stroke settings.

description: The positive-direction stroke-limit switch was triggered; the manual states this alarm is generated when the machine reaches the stroke end.
possible_causes: Physical positive travel limit reached.
corrective_action: Follow the machine-specific overtravel recovery procedure; do not bypass the safety limit. Inspect the cause of the excessive travel before returning to production.

description: A position-coder error was detected on the analog spindle.
possible_causes: Analog-spindle position-coder error.
corrective_action: Inspect the analog spindle position coder and associated wiring/connections according to the FANUC spindle maintenance procedure.

description: An error occurred while reading data from the SIC-LSI on the analog spindle amplifier side.
possible_causes: Spindle-amplifier/SIC-LSI data-read error.
corrective_action: Inspect the spindle amplifier and associated spindle-control circuitry according to the FANUC maintenance manual.

description: A serial-spindle data error is detected.
possible_causes: Serial-spindle sensor/data error.
corrective_action: The referenced FANUC alarm list specifies replacing the sensor for this amplifier indication; verify the exact spindle amplifier and machine configuration before replacement.

description: A serial-spindle data-transfer error is detected.
possible_causes: Serial-spindle data transfer error.
corrective_action: The referenced FANUC alarm list specifies replacing the sensor for this amplifier indication; verify the exact spindle amplifier and machine configuration before replacement.

description: A soft-phase error is detected in the serial-spindle system.
possible_causes: Incorrect sensor parameter setting; electrical noise; sensor fault.
corrective_action: Check and correct sensor parameter settings; take action against noise; replace the sensor if required, as specified in the FANUC alarm list.

description: The motor position exceeded the safety-speed-zero monitoring width.
possible_causes: Motor position outside the safety-speed-zero monitoring range.
corrective_action: Perform operation within the safety-speed-zero range, as specified by the FANUC alarm list and applicable machine procedure.

description: Emergency-stop condition is active. On Haas Desktop Mill troubleshooting, the alarm may fail to reset when the primary E-stop cable is disconnected or damaged.
possible_causes: Primary E-stop cable disconnected; E-stop cable damaged; E-stop-related connection/port problem.
corrective_action: Check the E-stop cable and its connection. If the cable is undamaged, reconnect it and cycle machine power; if damaged, replace it and power cycle. Follow the applicable Haas service procedure.
source_document: Haas Desktop Mill Troubleshooting Guide TG0058; Haas Alarm Search Help RD0002
training_instruction: Explain Haas CNC milling alarm 107 (EMERGENCY STOP). Give the official description, documented possible causes, and official troubleshooting direction. Do not invent causes.
training_input: Brand: Haas; Machine type: CNC Milling; Controller scope: Haas Mill control (CHC/NGC where applicable); Alarm code: 107
training_output: Alarm: 107 - EMERGENCY STOP. Description: Emergency-stop condition is active. On Haas Desktop Mill troubleshooting, the alarm may fail to reset when the primary E-stop cable is disconnected or damaged. Possible causes: Primary E-stop cable disconnected; E-stop cable damaged; E-stop-related connection/port problem. Official corrective/troubleshooting direction: Check the E-stop cable and its connection. If the cable is undamaged, reconnect it and cycle machine power; if damaged, replace it and power cycle. Follow the applicable Haas service procedure.

description: The compressed air supplied to the machine is below the minimum pressure or flow required.
possible_causes: Insufficient compressed-air pressure or flow; contamination affecting the air-pressure sensor.
corrective_action: Check the air supply and pressure. Check the air-pressure sensor for contamination; replace the sensor if required. Haas states that the air supply should be clean and dry.

description: The spindle drive has reported a fault. Haas directs the technician to inspect the spindle-drive error code for the specific cause.
possible_causes: Multiple possible spindle-drive faults; DC-bus problem; vector-drive short circuit; drive or motor/cable fault depending on the machine/control configuration.
corrective_action: Read the error code shown on the spindle drive and follow the applicable Haas spindle-drive troubleshooting procedure. Do not assume a single root cause from alarm 123 alone.

corrective_action: Follow the Haas spindle-motor troubleshooting procedure for the applicable machine. Inspect/test the spindle motor, overheat sensor, vector drive, fans, cables, Wye/Delta contacts and encoder belt as applicable.
